The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 37e6d650c989c3fb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 50. statement: Let L/K be a regular extension of finitely generated fields over C, with trdegC L ≤ d. Suppose it has a positive-dimensional projective generic model G/K that is geometrically ϵ0-lc Fano, where ϵ0 > 0 is fixed: −KG is ample and Q-Cartier, and the geometric underlying variety is ϵ0-lc. Let σ be a form on L of index at most r, with effective boundary on G and with Aσ ≥ 0 on all absolute divisorial valuations of L. For every nonzero divisorial valuation u of K, set Āσ(u) = inf w|K =u Aσ(w), and use the same notation for other forms. (1) There is a form σK on K, with index bounded only in terms of d, ϵ0, r, such that 1 2Āσ(u) ≤ AσK (u) ≤ Āσ(u) for every nonzero divisorial u. (2) Let ψ be a form on L with effective boundary on G, Aψ > 0 on all nonzero absolute divisorial valuations, and Aσ ≤ CAψ. For every λ > 0, there is δ > 0, depending only on d, ϵ0, r, C, λ, such that an integral-valued nonzero divisorial valuation u of K with Āψ(u) < δ has an integral-valued divisorial lift v on L satisfying v|K ∈ Q>0u, Aψ(v) < λ. (3) Let χ, ψ be forms with effective boundaries on G; neither is required to be absolutely lc in this part. Suppose that, for a fixed c > 0, Aχ(w) ≥ cAψ(w) on all nonzero divisorial w with Aσ(w) = 0. There is D ≥ 0, depending only on d, ϵ0, r, c, such that (10.2) Aχ(w) ≥ cAψ(w) − DAσ(w) whenever w is trivial on K, or u = w|K is nonzero and Āσ(u) = 0. The boundaries on G are interpreted by dividing out a base volume form as above. All comparisons allow positive rational scalings, and integral-valued valuations need not be primitive. If K = C, the first part has no nonzero valuations to test and a constant form of index one suffices; the second part is vacuous, while the third part includes every nonzero divisorial valuation of L.
